plain_result: A new supervised linear reader recovered the starting state and action from saved language-model vectors on all 24 questions. It used 16 combinations for fitting and 8 for checking. None had tied top scores.
question: Can we read which rule-table row a question asks for, before trying to write the rule outcome as an answer?

panel.duplicate_handling: Four byte-identical world copies were collapsed before splitting. They are not 96 independent examples.
panel.split: For starting state s, hold out action s modulo 3. The other two actions are used for fitting. All states and actions occur in fitting.
panel.exposure: All 24 questions and earlier model behavior were already exposed during development. Excluded means excluded from this new fit only; these are not fresh confirmation questions.

method.reader: New factorized supervised linear address reader, outside the language model.
method.arithmetic: FP64 (64-bit floating point). One fixed ridge fit; independent SVD reconstruction checked arithmetic and exact scoring decisions.
method.fit_targets: The stated starting state and action, not the next-state answer.
method.gate: Strict unique correct address for all 16 fitted and all 8 excluded combinations.

limits: This constructs a new offline reader; it does not show the old connector learned to read addresses.
The reader has not been installed in a live model or tested at the host arithmetic precision.
No answer writing, multi-step rule composition or use of unseen world rules was tested.
This does not identify the cause of the original learning failure or establish novelty.
The second development attempt and forced-row negative results remain unchanged.
next_step: A separate writer positive control would test whether a supplied outcome-probability vector can produce the correct answer through the frozen host. Supplying that answer code is not an organ-transplant result. Joining reader and writer requires its own review; no automatic next study.
transformation: Selected completed aggregate counts, work totals, method and limits only. No raw hidden states, coefficients, prediction vectors, process identifiers or private account details copied.
